thread:
leo: quick follow-up: validator alias mitigations are live in canary but we still see a small tail of rejects. some payloads have both `params` and `arguments` which is ambiguous.

anika: if both exist, our coercion logic currently prefers `params`. maybe the old SDK had `arguments` expected. the validator must flag ambiguous dual-field as `ambiguous_wrapper`.

harpreet: propose rule: if both present, prefer `params` and emit `ambiguous_wrapper` audit event but accept. update schema docs to mark `arguments` deprecated.

leo: ok. also need a console view that surfaces deprecated-field warnings by customer for next 7 days. anika: i'll add a deprecation warnings endpoint to the sample indexer.

ops-bot: note: retention for reject samples set to 2h for this incident. infra-bot: router canary rollout progressing; region eu-west at 10% now.

leo: thanks. plan to close incident after 2 hours of stable reject rate under baseline. reconvene in 30m.
